text:
morgan: Heads-up — noticed infra-builder images are being overwritten in the registry when CI retries. This means our prod clusters sometimes pull a different base digest than the one we validated. Not good.

alex: ugh. where is the overwrite happening, GHA or our bakery job?

morgan: bakery job. we're using tags like `bakery-latest` and the publish step uses `docker push $TAG` without pinning digests. retry path reuses same tag.

jin: we should switch to publishing by digest and writing the digest to the release artifact (and git ref). CI can then deploy via digest.

kyle: agree. small UX hit for devs but safer. Also need to sign images with cosign and attach SBOMs. Otherwise we can't prove immutability.

morgan: proposal: in builder pipeline, after build, run `docker manifest inspect` then `docker push` and capture the produced digest into `image_digest.txt`. Upload that as build artifact and include in Helm Chart values as `image.digest`.

alex: can we do that without breaking our GitOps flow? We currently render Helm templates in the deploy pipeline based on tags.

jin: two-step change: 1) allow Helm values to accept `image.digest` OR `image.tag`. 2) update automation that writes a small kustomize/values patch with the digest for the release pipeline. That patch lives in a releases bucket, not main git.

kyle: and for SBOMs — we rotate SBOMs every publish and attach as artifact `sbom.json`. ci-bot should verify SBOM present before allowing promote.

ci-bot: CI policy check failed: builder image missing sbom.json in last 3 builds. See run https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/4532 for details. :warning:

morgan: good call. let's add a pipeline gate that fails publish if `sbom.json` missing or cosign signature missing. Also add a 5m TTL on the bakery cache to avoid long-lived caches that hide env drift.

alex: 5m TTL sounds aggressive — will bump build times. Can we do LRU cache with max-age 6h for base layers, but force rebuild for top-level tool layers after 5m?

morgan: yes — split caches: `base-layer-cache:max-age=6h` and `tool-layer-cache:ttl=5m`. That reduces full rebuilds but keeps tool drift low.

jin: quick config snippet for the bakery job we can use in GHA:```yaml
- name: Build and push
  env:
    IMAGE: ghcr.io/redwood/bakery:${GITHUB_SHA}
  run: |
    docker build -t $IMAGE .
    DIGEST=$(docker push $IMAGE | tail -n1 | awk '{print $3}')
    echo $DIGEST > image_digest.txt
    cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEY $IMAGE@${DIGEST}
    sbom-tool generate -o sbom.json $IMAGE@${DIGEST}
```

kyle: one more: add an automated cleanup job that converts any mutable tag we still push into a redirect tag pointing to the digest (registry alias) so older manifests don't get silently replaced.

morgan: good. And ops-bot — can you add an alert if a node pulls an image whose registry digest doesn't match the digest in our release artifacts?

ops-bot: Alert created: `image-digest-mismatch` — will trigger when kubepuller sees a digest deviation between registry and release artifact. Pager rotation on-call: infra-sre.

alex: timeline? I can take the Helm changes + GitOps patching. Jin can own bakery CI changes. Kyle: signing/SBOM gating and ops-bot alert. Morgan will coordinate rollout and update runbooks.

morgan: plan: quick PRs this week. I'll open the tickets and add to eng-infra board. If anyone hits blockers ping me @morgan. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Note: please ensure artifact retention for `image_digest.txt` is >=30d for audit. Current default is 7d.

morgan: noted — I'll set retention to 90d for builder artifacts.

kyle: also add a recovery play: if digest missing, fallback to last-signed digest and auto-rollback helm release. minimal blast radius.

morgan: added to runbook. thanks all.
